title.narrative: PROMOTION OF DOCUMENTATION, CULTIVATION AND PROCESSING OF VALUE-ADDED TRADITIONAL MEDICINE AND FOOD SUPPLEMENTS

description.narrative: This project proposal aims to explore and document requirements for the integration of traditional medicine into primary care settings, with the goal of enhancing patient-centred healthcare. Traditional medicine is an important component of the health care system in Tanzania and in other developing countries. However, indigenous knowledge about herbal medicines of many Tanzanian cultures is scarcely investigated, documented for the present and future generation as well as not exploited for socio-economic development for the communities. The aim of the present study is to document traditional and herbal medicines and practices used by communities in the Lake Victoria Basin in Tanzania to treat and manage human diseases and ailments.
